phases.title: Board Dogfood Requirements And Live State Baseline
phases.goal: Establish the real `coordination` board as the v1.8 dogfood anchor, capture baseline board health, and prepare UAT evidence tracking before behavior changes.
successCriteria: The `coordination` board is confirmed as real project state with its canonical `.aof/boards/coordination/BOARD.json` preserved.
Baseline CLI output is captured for `aof boards list`, `show`, `validate`, `index`, and `doctor` in human and JSON forms where supported.
Baseline output is compared against canonical board JSON and any mismatches are logged as UAT findings.
A v1.8 UAT log exists with finding IDs, repro steps, severity, expected behavior, and resolution status.

phases.title: Board Attachment And Sync UAT
phases.goal: Attach the live `coordination` board to milestone `v1.8`, sync roadmap phases into phase-backed tasks, and verify milestone binding failures and success paths.
successCriteria: `aof boards milestone attach coordination --milestone v1.8 --roadmap .planning/ROADMAP.md` binds the board to the active milestone.
`aof boards sync coordination --milestone v1.8` creates one board task per v1.8 roadmap phase.
Sync before attach, missing milestone arguments, and wrong milestone arguments produce clear human and JSON errors with next actions.
Board doctor reports the expected binding and task sync health after attach/sync.

phases.title: Boards UI Dogfood
phases.goal: Use `aof boards ui` against the real board and verify the UI/API surface stays consistent with CLI output and canonical board files.
successCriteria: The boards UI opens for the AOF repo and displays the `coordination` board and synced phase tasks.
UI state for task columns, binding status, execution status, and next actions matches CLI/API/canonical JSON.
Supported task moves or state updates made through the UI persist to canonical board files.
Repair, sync, assignment, and incomplete-state feedback is actionable when surfaced in the UI.
Any confirmed UI defects receive targeted regression coverage and `npm run ui:build` verification.

phases.title: Assignment And Execution UAT
phases.goal: Validate that synced phase tasks can move from tracking to execution through configured agents, execution records, and safe status updates.
successCriteria: `aof boards agents` lists configured board agents for the AOF project.
A synced phase task can be assigned to a configured agent when the selected execution path is safe.
Assignment writes an execution record and updates the task summary without corrupting board state.
Blocked, waiting, failed, and complete execution statuses can be inspected and updated.
If full live `runPhase()` execution is unsafe for the selected task, the boundary is documented and a controlled execution-status path is verified instead.

phases.title: UAT Findings Hardening And Closeout
phases.goal: Resolve confirmed dogfood findings, verify the complete v1.8 board workflow, and close the milestone with traceable evidence.
successCriteria: Every confirmed UAT finding is linked to a fix, regression test, or explicit deferral with rationale.
Internal bridge assets are verified not to leak into rendered Claude or Codex runtime assets.
Affected UAT steps are rerun after fixes and recorded as passing or explicitly deferred.
Focused board unit/integration tests pass after fixes.
UI build/API verification and PowerShell parity checks run when touched surfaces require them.
The milestone closes with a UAT report, requirement coverage, roadmap traceability, and archive-ready planning artifacts.
